reduction: n = √((1 + 2x) ÷ (1 − x)) with x = c R(λ) ρ_m, c = 0.994335, evaluated at each wavelength of 380–780 nm every 5 nm, to six significant figures (decision-p14-t49h-gas-index §1.2); the stated band: ±0.003 in n. k = 0, as ruled (decision-p14-t49h-gas-index §2.6): the liquid is colourless in the visible. Not drawn: the tail of the gas's ã–X̃ band, which view/atmosphere/absorbers.ts's SO2 cross-sections put at 2.4 × 10⁻²² cm² at 383 nm and 1.2 × 10⁻²⁴ cm² at 400 nm (Hermans, Vandaele and Fally 2009, the gas at 298 K); at the liquid's number density, σN would give k of 1 × 10⁻⁵ at 383 nm and 6 × 10⁻⁸ at 400 nm (computed), so the liquid's violet edge is not drawn.
